rv.q: 'Gatz' may be the world's least likely blockbuster show, but there's no doubt that it is one.

Gatz is a once-in-a-lifetime event that will scarcely appeal to every taste, but it is likely to be an extraordinary experience for ardent lovers of novelist F. Scott Fitzgerald and The Great Gatsby...
It is indeed one of the most tectonic-shifting, awe-inspiring stage works I'll have ever seen.
Gatz is a long but worthwhile way to experience it in its fullness, made even richer with Collins's staging.
